description: Runs a bounded real no-worktree qualification worker through the qualification host. It proves fleet plumbing, not an LLM runtime.
embedding_description: Run an internal, bounded fleet lifecycle qualification that creates a synthetic no-worktree worker through the declared qualification host, waits for its real watch bridge registration, claims its durable role using the registered identity, verifies role-addressed watcher delivery to that same instance, releases the role, and retires the worker without leaving a branch or worktree.
